text:
maria (Support): Customer reported intermittent 502/504s hitting hosted inference during a large fanout request pattern, tenant ID t-74f2, starting ~09:12 UTC. They see a burst of ~200 parallel calls, ~10% fail with 502 and 504. sample request-id: req_4f9a2c.
raj (SRE): Thanks — can you paste a raw curl and a couple of response headers/log lines? Need to confirm if it's upstream reset vs gateway timeout.
maria (Support): curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer redacted' -d '{"model":"rw-infer-3b","input":"hi"}'
Response headers (fail): HTTP/2 502
server: envoy
x-request-id: req_4f9a2c
upstream-host: 10.11.7.22:8080
via: 1.1 frontdoor-lb
body: "upstream connection reset"
sam (Infra): Frontdoor shows many concurrent downstream streams to our ingress pool. Envoy logs around that ts show 502s with ECONNRESET when connecting to upstream TCP. Could be keepalive pool exhaustion or connection timeouts on the pool.
monitoring-bot: Alert: frontdoor.request_5xx_rate tenant=t-74f2 spike at 09:12:30 UTC, 5xx_rate=12% over 1m, upstream_connect_failures increased.
anna (Eng): We recently enabled request fanout for embeddings to increase throughput, that spins up parallel sub-requests to dedicated workers. Do we have per-upstream connection caps?
raj (SRE): Yes, upstreams are set to 100 concurrent connections per worker container. With 200 parallel inbound calls, some upstreams get >100 active attempts due to uneven hashing -> connection queueing then resets. Envoy's connection pool returns RST when queue exceeds limit.
maria (Support): Customer repro steps: ramp to 200 parallel curl processes, each streaming a ~2k token generation. Repro 70-90s into sustained fanout -> error spike.
sam (Infra): Quick mitigation: enable short-lived request queuing at frontdoor (envoy: upstream_connection_options: max_requests_in_flight=50) or throttle fanout client side. We can also enable a soft limit that schedules retries with jitter rather than immediate parallel bursts.
anna (Eng): Code fix: add per-tenant fanout semaphore (limit concurrent subrequests to 40) and exponential backoff for subrequest 5xx. We'll open PR.
raj (SRE): For immediate customer relief I can temporarily increase upstream connection pool to 200 for tenant t-74f2 and toggle a connection drain window, but that's risky at scale. Recommend we enable connection pooling adjustments only for this tenant via route metadata.
maria (Support): Customer asked for ETA — they want it fixed asap, prefer config change over app patch.
sam (Infra): I'll roll a targeted Envoy config patch to bump per-upstream connections and enable keepalive to reduce TCP churn. Rolling in 5-min canary to 10% traffic for t-74f2. deploy-bot: canary rollout started (canary_id=canary-517, targets: t-74f2 route).
raj (SRE): Watch metrics: upstream_connect_failures, envoy.upstream_rq_5xx, keepalive_reuse_ratio. If errors drop after canary, we can promote.
monitoring-bot: Metric check scheduled in 2m.
maria (Support): Noted. I'll inform customer of temporary config canary and request them to retry ramp in 15m.
anna (Eng): Opening GH issue and PR: GH-issue #4128, PR #4130 (adds semaphore + backoff). Owning: anna.
raj (SRE): Postmortem items: 1) add per-route connection limits visible in Console 2) autosuggest client-side fanout limits in Optimize 3) add runbook entry for targeted frontdoor tweaks. Owning: raj.
maria (Support): Thanks team. I'll follow up with customer and close loop once canary looks stable. :white_check_mark:
